text:
Amanda: Heads up — I'm getting multiple customer issues for the search API but incident-bot didn't page the on-call. I created an incident and it shows in the channel but no pages landed. Anyone seeing this?
incident-bot: Incident INC-4721 created. Attempting to page on-call via PagerDuty... status: queued -> suppressed (see logs)
Sam: I'm on it. Not seeing any incoming pages in PagerDuty for that incident id. Checking incident-bot logs now.
Sam: Command I'm running: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/incident-bot | grep -i pager -n`
Sam: Relevant log excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T04:11:02Z [pager-relay] outbound request to pd/v1/events -> 200
2026-03-17T04:12:14Z [webhook-consumer] received webhook: id=abc123 headers={X-PD-Signature:sha256=...}
2026-03-17T04:12:14Z [webhook-consumer] signature header missing, rejecting webhook
```
Mike: Confirmed from relay side: PagerDuty webhooks are arriving but our validation step returns "signature header missing". Looks like PD sent `X-PD-Signature` but our parser expects `X-Signature`. Manual pages (phone call) still work — Lina said she got a call earlier.
Lina: I didn't get the automated pages, Amanda had to call me directly. No missed ack on my side once I was contacted.
Sam: Quick mitigation: will add fallback to accept `X-PD-Signature` header and reprocess the queued webhooks. Patching now.
Sam: Patch snippet I'm applying:
```
// accept either header name for backwards/forward compatibility
const sig = req.headers['x-signature'] || req.headers['x-pd-signature'] || req.headers['x-pd_signature'];
if (!sig) { return reject('missing signature'); }
```
incident-bot: Hotfix applied to webhook consumer. Accepting `X-PD-Signature` in addition to legacy headers. Reprocessing queued webhooks: 18 items queued.
Amanda: I just got the automated page. Reprocess pushed 16 -> delivered, 2 still pending retry. :thumbsup:
Mike: I'll open a follow-up to harden the header parsing and add unit/integration tests guarding header name changes and case sensitivity. Filing ticket INF-3124 and assigning to eng-infra.
Amanda: Customer impact: support triaged 6 distinct customer incidents tied to the search error window (start ~04:11 UTC -> ~04:18 UTC). We already notified affected customers and created temporary credits. No data loss.
Lina: Any SLA fallout? We may need to notify CS about potential SLA noise for those accounts.
Sam: Root cause hypothesis: PagerDuty introduced a header name change in a minor rollout (no version bump). Our validation logic was brittle to header name variants and case.
Sam: Actions: 1) durable fix in webhook library (INF-3124), 2) add synthetic webhook monitor that verifies end-to-end paging on deploy, 3) add alert if queued pages > 5 for > 5m, 4) postmortem + customer communication draft.
Mike: ETA on durable fix? I'll prioritize it this afternoon.
Amanda: Good work. We'll run the postmortem tomorrow. For now, manual paging fallback + hotfix covers live traffic.
incident-bot: Reprocessed queue status: delivered=16, retrying=2, failed=0. Will continue retries per backoff policy.
Amanda: Closing incident thread here; moving to postmortem docs and tagging support follow-ups. Thanks everyone. :heart:
